altbuild: none: no alternative compiled target build is declared for this Python module; platform robustness remains a calibration/review limitation.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative build declared, so the CLI floor remains null. Separate Windows Python 3.12.14 versus Linux container Python 3.12.10 comparison passed; per-observable measurements are in comment/validation-evidence.json. This does not establish all-platform robustness.

warrant: Position, velocity and body angular rate are graded in SI with absolute 5 mm, 1e-4 m/s and 1e-6 rad/s limits; attitude uses 1e-5 rad sign-invariant rotation distance at fixed NASA timestamps, independently of adaptive step bookkeeping. The pinned smooth dynamics use dopri5 with max_step=0.0625 s, and cubic interpolation introduces an observable-specific numerical floor; density, sound speed, viscosity and true airspeed use their own absolute-plus-relative limits and evaluation of the original Planet output on the sampled state. The measured Docker numerical-noise spread is 7.19102e-13; Windows-versus-Linux outputs also pass all per-observable bounds. Published NESC data separately anchor the pristine nominal trajectory; variants are never treated as published nominal cases. Gravity-sign, frame-transform and inertial-term faults cross the physical limits by large margins. The curator approved these scientific equivalence budgets after reading the calibration, rather than setting them equal to tiny two-ULP spreads.
calibration_status: Curator finalized the full calibration proposal after the first Docker selfcheck: approved proposal, disclose limitations and continue submitting the PR (2026-09-07).
